title: ShieldCLIP: Selective Safety Alignment for Harmful Content Mitigation in Multimodal Foundation Models
title_zh: ShieldCLIP：多模态基础模型中有害内容缓解的选择性安全对齐

paragraphs.en: Multimodal encoders such as CLIP underlie many downstream systems, but their web-scale training data embed harmful associations that safety alignment must suppress without unnecessarily changing benign representations. Because ethical and practical constraints prevent collecting real unsafe content at scale, existing datasets pair safe real samples with generated counterparts, but label every generated sample unsafe, even when one modality is individually safe. To address this, we introduce ShieldCLIP, the first framework to condition safety alignment on the observed safety state of each modality rather than the origin of a sample, preserving safe content while redirecting only what is unsafe. We also introduce ViSUv2, a 195k-quadruplet dataset with independent per-modality safety labels across 578 concepts and 28 categories. Using these labels, ShieldCLIP defines a four-way conditional objective beyond pair-level supervision: safe content is anchored, unsafe modalities are redirected to their safe counterparts, mixed pairs update only the unsafe branch, and coherence is enforced when both are unsafe. We evaluate ShieldCLIP on cross-modal retrieval, text-to-image generation with Stable Diffusion v1.4 and SDXL, and image-to-text generation with LLaVA. Across these settings, ShieldCLIP consistently reduces harmful outputs over prior safety-aligned encoders and strong mitigation baselines, while preserving the utility of the original embedding space. Extensive ablation studies further show that both modality-specific supervision and the selective alignment objective contribute to these gains. Source code, trained models, and ViSUv2 (under a controlled-access protocol) will be made publicly available at https://aimagelab.github.io/ShieldCLIP/ .
paragraphs.zh: CLIP 等多模态编码器是许多下游系统的基础，但其网络规模的训练数据中嵌入了有害关联，安全性对齐必须抑制这些关联，同时避免不必要地改变无害的表示。 由于伦理和实际限制使得无法大规模收集真实的危险内容，现有数据集将安全的真实样本与生成的对应样本配对，但将所有生成样本标记为危险，即使其中某个模态单独来看是安全的。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 ShieldCLIP——首个将安全性对齐条件化于每个模态的观测安全状态而非样本来源的框架，从而在保留安全内容的同时仅重新引导危险内容。 我们还引入了 ViSUv2，这是一个包含 19.5 万个四元组的数据集，覆盖 578 个概念和 28 个类别，并为每个模态提供了独立的安全性标签。 基于这些标签，ShieldCLIP 定义了一个超越样本对级监督的四向条件目标函数：安全内容被锚定，危险模态被重新引导至其安全对应项，混合配对仅更新危险分支，而当两个模态均危险时则强制保持一致性。 我们在跨模态检索、结合 Stable Diffusion v1.4 和 SDXL 的文本到图像生成，以及结合 LLaVA 的图像到文本生成任务上对 ShieldCLIP 进行了评估。 在这些不同场景中，ShieldCLIP 相较于先前的安全性对齐编码器和强效缓解基线模型，能持续减少有害输出，同时保留原始嵌入空间的实用性。 广泛的消融研究进一步表明，模态特定的监督与选择性对齐目标共同促成了这些性能提升。 源代码、训练好的模型以及 ViSUv2（受控访问协议下）将在 https://aimagelab.github.io/ShieldCLIP/ 上公开提供。

sents.zh: 本文包含有害或露骨内容的示例和描述，包括性内容和暴力内容，部分读者可能会感到不安或冒犯。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models, such as CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , LLaVA ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024a ) , Stable Diffusion ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Esser et al., 2024 ; Podell et al., 2024 ) , and FLUX ( Black Forest Labs, 2024 ) , have enabled rich cross-modal associations between images and text, powering applications from retrieval and captioning to large-scale generative systems. These models derive their generalization abilities from massive web-scale datasets, but uncontrolled data collection can introduce harmful biases ( Birhane et al., 2021 ) , unsafe associations ( Abid et al., 2021 ) , and inappropriate content ( Schuhmann et al., 2022 ) . Their outputs can consequently drift into sexual, violent, or otherwise harmful content, raising serious concerns about responsible deployment ( Bommasani et al., 2021 ; Weidinger et al., 2022 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 多模态基础模型的最新进展，例如 CLIP（Radford 等人，2021）、LLaVA（Liu 等人，2023；Liu 等人，2024a）、Stable Diffusion（Rombach 等人，2022；Esser 等人，2024；Podell 等人，2024）以及 FLUX（Black Forest Labs，2024），使得图像与文本之间能够建立丰富的跨模态关联，从而推动了从信息检索和图像描述到大规模生成系统等各种应用的发展。 这些模型通过大规模网络级数据集获得了其泛化能力，但未经控制的数据收集可能会引入有害的偏见（Birhane 等人，2021）、不安全的关联（Abid 等人，2021）以及不当内容（Schuhmann 等人，2022）。 因此，它们的输出可能会偏离到包含性、暴力或其他有害内容的方向，这引发了人们对负责任部署的严重担忧（Bommasani 等人，2021；Weidinger 等人，2022）。

sents.en: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models, such as CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , LLaVA ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024a ) , Stable Diffusion ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Esser et al., 2024 ; Podell et al., 2024 ) , and FLUX ( Black Forest Labs, 2024 ) , have enabled rich cross-modal associations between images and text, powering applications from retrieval and captioning to large-scale generative systems.

sents.zh: 这些模型通过大规模网络级数据集获得了其泛化能力，但未经控制的数据收集可能会引入有害的偏见（Birhane 等人，2021）、不安全的关联（Abid 等人，2021）以及不当内容（Schuhmann 等人，2022）。

sents.en: Their outputs can consequently drift into sexual, violent, or otherwise harmful content, raising serious concerns about responsible deployment ( Bommasani et al., 2021 ; Weidinger et al., 2022 ) .
sents.zh: 因此，它们的输出可能会偏离到包含性、暴力或其他有害内容的方向，这引发了人们对负责任部署的严重担忧（Bommasani 等人，2021；Weidinger 等人，2022）。

paragraphs.en: A central challenge lies in the shared embedding space learned by models such as CLIP. This space supports multimodal retrieval ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2024 ) , text-to-image generation ( Podell et al., 2024 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ) , and visual dialog and reasoning ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024a ) . Unsafe prompts or images can be projected into harmful regions of this space, steering downstream pipelines toward inappropriate outputs. Conversely, benign prompts can yield unsafe generations because of biases in learned associations ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ) . Improving safety at the encoder level can therefore benefit several downstream systems without modifying each decoder independently.
paragraphs.zh: 一个核心挑战在于 CLIP 等模型所学习的共享嵌入空间。 该空间支持多模态检索（Wang 等人，2024；Wei 等人，2024）、文本到图像生成（Podell 等人，2024；Rombach 等人，2022），以及视觉对话与推理（Liu 等人，2023；Liu 等人，2024a）。 不安全提示或图像可能被投影到该空间的有害区域，从而引导下游流程产生不当输出。 相反，由于学习到的关联关系存在偏差，良性提示也可能生成不安全的内容（Schramowski 等人，2023）。 因此，在编码器层面提升安全性，可以在不独立修改每个解码器的情况下，为多个下游系统带来益处。

sents.en: A central challenge lies in the shared embedding space learned by models such as CLIP.
sents.zh: 一个核心挑战在于 CLIP 等模型所学习的共享嵌入空间。

sents.en: This space supports multimodal retrieval ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2024 ) , text-to-image generation ( Podell et al., 2024 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ) , and visual dialog and reasoning ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024a ) .
sents.zh: 该空间支持多模态检索（Wang 等人，2024；Wei 等人，2024）、文本到图像生成（Podell 等人，2024；Rombach 等人，2022），以及视觉对话与推理（Liu 等人，2023；Liu 等人，2024a）。

sents.en: Unsafe prompts or images can be projected into harmful regions of this space, steering downstream pipelines toward inappropriate outputs.
sents.zh: 不安全提示或图像可能被投影到该空间的有害区域，从而引导下游流程产生不当输出。

sents.en: Conversely, benign prompts can yield unsafe generations because of biases in learned associations ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ) .
sents.zh: 相反，由于学习到的关联关系存在偏差，良性提示也可能生成不安全的内容（Schramowski 等人，2023）。

sents.en: Improving safety at the encoder level can therefore benefit several downstream systems without modifying each decoder independently.
sents.zh: 因此，在编码器层面提升安全性，可以在不独立修改每个解码器的情况下，为多个下游系统带来益处。

paragraphs.en: Embedding-level mitigation offers a general way to intervene before decoding ( Kim and Qi, 2025 ) : unsafe inputs are redirected toward benign representations, while safe content is anchored to the original embedding space ( Liu et al., 2024b ; Poppi et al., 2024 ; Ahn and Jung, 2025 ) . Recent work extends this line by restructuring the shared space itself ( Poppi et al., 2025 ) or by bounding how far unsafe concepts are displaced ( Yousaf et al., 2026a ) . The concern motivating both is that aggressive redirection collapses the semantic structure of the space and erodes utility in ways that standard metrics do not expose ( Yousaf et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 嵌入层级的缓解措施提供了一种在解码前进行干预的通用方法（Kim 和 Qi，2025）：不安全输入会被引导至良性表示，而安全内容则被锚定在原始嵌入空间中（Liu 等人，2024b；Poppi 等人，2024；Ahn 和 Jung，2025）。 近期的研究通过重构共享空间本身（Poppi 等人，2025），或限制不安全概念被位移的程度（Yousaf 等人，2026a），进一步拓展了这一思路。 推动这两种方法的核心担忧是：激进的重新定向会破坏空间的语义结构，并以标准指标无法揭示的方式削弱其效用（Yousaf 等人，2026b）。

sents.en: The concern motivating both is that aggressive redirection collapses the semantic structure of the space and erodes utility in ways that standard metrics do not expose ( Yousaf et al., 2026b ) .
sents.zh: 推动这两种方法的核心担忧是：激进的重新定向会破坏空间的语义结构，并以标准指标无法揭示的方式削弱其效用（Yousaf 等人，2026b）。

paragraphs.en: How supervision is obtained compounds this risk. Because real unsafe images and captions cannot be collected at scale for ethical and practical reasons, existing paired-data formulations synthesize them instead: a safe caption is rewritten into an unsafe variant conditioned on a harmful concept, and an image is generated from that unsafe caption. The resulting pair is then treated as jointly unsafe simply because it was produced by this pipeline, even though neither rewriting a caption around a harmful concept nor rendering an image from it guarantees that the output is actually harmful: a caption about fraud may produce a visually harmless office scene, while a benign caption about an operating room may yield disturbing surgical imagery. Such cases are not marginal. In the data we collect, 39% of generated pairs combine a safe modality with an unsafe one, so uniform redirection alters benign representations and introduces conflicting supervision whenever the two modalities disagree.
paragraphs.zh: 监督信号的获取方式会加剧这种风险。 由于伦理和实际原因，无法大规模收集真实的不安全图像与配文，因此现有的配对数据方法转而采用合成方式：将安全的配文根据某种有害概念改写为不安全版本，再基于该不安全配文生成图像。 由此生成的配对数据仅因通过这一流程产生而被视为共同不安全，尽管围绕有害概念改写配文或据此生成图像本身，都无法确保输出内容确实有害：例如，关于欺诈的配文可能生成视觉上无害的办公室场景，而关于手术室的良性配文却可能产生令人不安的外科手术画面。 这类情况并非个例。 在我们收集的数据中，39% 的生成配对将安全模态与不安全模态结合，因此当两种模态不一致时，统一重定向会改变良性表示并引入冲突的监督信号。

sents.en: How supervision is obtained compounds this risk.
sents.zh: 监督信号的获取方式会加剧这种风险。

paragraphs.en: To address this problem, we introduce ShieldCLIP , a framework for selective safety alignment in CLIP-like multimodal encoders. It is trained on data that preserve the semantic correspondence between real and generated image-text pairs while carrying an independent safety label for each generated modality. The resulting formulation distinguishes safe-safe, unsafe-unsafe, safe-text/unsafe-image, and unsafe-text/safe-image pairs, allowing supervision to follow the observed content rather than its source.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 ShieldCLIP——一个用于 CLIP 类多模态编码器中选择性安全对齐的框架。 该框架在保留真实图像与生成图像-文本对之间语义对应关系的同时，为每个生成的模态附加独立的安全标签的数据上进行训练。 由此形成的表述方法能够区分“安全-安全”、“不安全-不安全”、“安全文本/不安全图像”以及“不安全文本/安全图像”四类配对，从而使得监督机制可以依据观察到的内容而非其来源进行执行。

sents.en: To address this problem, we introduce ShieldCLIP , a framework for selective safety alignment in CLIP-like multimodal encoders.
sents.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 ShieldCLIP——一个用于 CLIP 类多模态编码器中选择性安全对齐的框架。

sents.en: It is trained on data that preserve the semantic correspondence between real and generated image-text pairs while carrying an independent safety label for each generated modality.
sents.zh: 该框架在保留真实图像与生成图像-文本对之间语义对应关系的同时，为每个生成的模态附加独立的安全标签的数据上进行训练。

sents.en: The resulting formulation distinguishes safe-safe, unsafe-unsafe, safe-text/unsafe-image, and unsafe-text/safe-image pairs, allowing supervision to follow the observed content rather than its source.
sents.zh: 由此形成的表述方法能够区分“安全-安全”、“不安全-不安全”、“安全文本/不安全图像”以及“不安全文本/安全图像”四类配对，从而使得监督机制可以依据观察到的内容而非其来源进行执行。

paragraphs.en: We further introduce ViSUv2 , a dataset of 195k real/generated image-text quadruplets. ViSU ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) pairs safe image-text samples with generated counterparts under a common safety assignment and a 20-category taxonomy. ViSUv2 retains this paired structure while labeling generated captions and images independently, expanding the taxonomy to 28 categories grounded in 578 fine-grained concepts, and using more recent language and diffusion models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步引入了 ViSUv2，这是一个包含 19.5 万个真实/生成图像-文本四元组的数据集。 ViSU（Poppi 等人，2024）在共同的安全分配和 20 个类别的分类体系下，将安全的图像-文本样本与其生成的对应样本进行配对。 ViSUv2 保留了这种配对结构，同时对生成的标题和图像进行独立标注，将分类体系扩展至 28 个类别（基于 578 个细粒度概念），并使用了更新的语言模型和扩散模型。

sents.zh: 我们进一步引入了 ViSUv2，这是一个包含 19.5 万个真实/生成图像-文本四元组的数据集。

sents.en: ViSU ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) pairs safe image-text samples with generated counterparts under a common safety assignment and a 20-category taxonomy.
sents.zh: ViSU（Poppi 等人，2024）在共同的安全分配和 20 个类别的分类体系下，将安全的图像-文本样本与其生成的对应样本进行配对。

sents.en: ViSUv2 retains this paired structure while labeling generated captions and images independently, expanding the taxonomy to 28 categories grounded in 578 fine-grained concepts, and using more recent language and diffusion models.
sents.zh: ViSUv2 保留了这种配对结构，同时对生成的标题和图像进行独立标注，将分类体系扩展至 28 个类别（基于 578 个细粒度概念），并使用了更新的语言模型和扩散模型。

paragraphs.en: These modality-level labels enable a conditional objective that pair-level alignment, which redirects all generated content under a shared safety assignment, cannot express. Real and generated-safe samples are preserved by aligning them with frozen CLIP anchors, while generated-unsafe samples are redirected toward their real safe counterparts. For mixed pairs, only the unsafe modality is updated while the safe branch is frozen; when both generated modalities are unsafe, an additional coherence term preserves their semantic correspondence during redirection. This selective design reduces over-sanitization while maintaining compatibility with systems built on the original CLIP geometry.
paragraphs.zh: 这些模态级别的标签使得条件目标能够与成对级别的对齐相配合，从而确保所有生成的内容在共享的安全指令下无法表达出任何不兼容的内容。 通过将真实样本和生成后的安全样本与冻结的 CLIP 锚点进行对齐，可以保留它们；而生成后的不安全样本则会被重新引导至其对应的真实安全样本。 对于混合配对，仅更新不安全的模态，同时保持安全分支冻结；当两种生成的模态均不安全时，会引入一个额外的连贯性项，在重新引导过程中保持它们的语义对应关系。 这种选择性设计减少了过度净化，同时仍能与基于原始 CLIP 几何结构构建的系统保持兼容性。

paragraphs.en: We first validate ViSUv2 against existing safety datasets in terms of diversity and harmfulness. We then evaluate ShieldCLIP across cross-modal retrieval, text-to-image generation with Stable Diffusion v1.4 and SDXL, and image-to-text generation with LLaVA. Beyond the main comparisons, we assess robustness across prompt distributions and different safety classifiers, study the contribution of modality-specific supervision and individual loss components, and analyze the safety–utility trade-off through retrieval, generation, and preservation metrics. Automatic evaluation is further complemented by human judgments of safety and content preservation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先从多样性和有害性两个维度，将 ViSUv2 与现有的安全数据集进行验证。 接着，我们在跨模态检索、使用 Stable Diffusion v1.4 和 SDXL 进行的文本到图像生成，以及使用 LLaVA 进行的图像到文本生成等方面对 ShieldCLIP 进行了评估。 除了主要对比之外，我们还评估了其在不同提示分布和安全分类器下的鲁棒性，研究了模态特定监督和各损失组件的贡献，并通过检索、生成和保留指标分析了安全性与效用之间的权衡关系。 自动评估还辅以人类对安全性和内容保留程度的判断。

paragraphs.en: Relation to the Conference Version. This work extends Safe-CLIP ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) , which addressed encoder-level mitigation through pair-level supervision that treated all generated samples as unsafe. Here, we formulate safety alignment at the modality level and condition the objective on the four possible safety states of generated image-text pairs. We replace ViSU with ViSUv2, which introduces independent text and image safety labels, expands the taxonomy from 20 to 28 categories, and includes human validation of the annotations. To disentangle the contribution of the new data from that of the selective objective, we conduct matched training experiments with Safe-CLIP and ShieldCLIP on both ViSU and ViSUv2. We further extend the experimental analysis with targeted ablation studies of modality-specific supervision and loss design, evaluation with SDXL and multiple safety classifiers, and a human preference study.
paragraphs.zh: 与会议版本的关系。 这项工作扩展了 Safe-CLIP（Poppi 等人，2024），该工作通过成对级监督在编码器层面进行缓解，并将所有生成的样本视为不安全样本。 在此，我们将安全对齐问题置于模态层面进行建模，并以生成图像-文本对的四种可能安全状态为条件来设定目标函数。 我们用 ViSUv2 替代了 ViSU，后者引入了独立的文本和图像安全标签，将分类体系从 20 个类别扩展至 28 个，并包含了人类对标注的验证。 为了区分新数据与选择性目标函数的各自贡献，我们在 ViSU 和 ViSUv2 上分别使用 Safe-CLIP 和 ShieldCLIP 进行了匹配的训练实验。 我们还通过针对模态特定监督与损失设计的消融研究、使用 SDXL 和多种安全分类器进行的评估，以及一项人类偏好研究，进一步拓展了实验分析。

paragraphs.en: Approaches to mitigating harmful content in text-to-image diffusion models can be categorized by their intervention stage: decoding-time methods, which act during image generation, and pre-decoding methods, which operate on latent or embedding representations beforehand.
paragraphs.zh: 文本到图像扩散模型中有害内容缓解方法可依据其干预阶段进行分类：解码时方法（在图像生成过程中起作用）和预解码方法（预先对潜在表示或嵌入表示进行操作）。

paragraphs.en: Decoding-Time Methods. These techniques directly regulate the diffusion process to prevent unsafe visual concepts from emerging. Model-editing approaches modify the generative parameters to erase undesired concepts, either by fine-tuning the U-Net ( Kumari et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024b ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Lyu et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) or by refining cross-attention layers for localized, scalable concept removal ( Gandikota et al., 2023 ; Gandikota et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2024 ) . More recent work addresses the residual weaknesses of this family: the entanglement between an erased concept and its semantic neighbors ( Shi et al., 2026 ) , the imprecision of purely text-side supervision ( Li et al., 2026 ; Vardhana and Biswas, 2026 ) , and the recovery of erased concepts under adversarial prompting ( Tsai et al., 2024 ; Yin et al., 2025 ) . While effective, these methods can over-suppress related but benign concepts and typically require retraining or separate fine-tuning for each new concept to be removed, limiting scalability. Inference-guidance techniques instead steer sampling without altering model weights, using latent-space directions ( Li et al., 2024a ) or classifier-free guidance mechanisms ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ) to avoid unsafe activations. They are lightweight and reversible but often less robust to ambiguous prompts and limited in controllability. In contrast to these generator-specific interventions, we operate upstream of the diffusion process by aligning the encoder that conditions generation. The resulting encoder can therefore be reused across compatible downstream systems that rely on the same CLIP backbone, without modifying their decoders.
paragraphs.zh: 解码时方法。 这些技术直接调控扩散过程，以防止不安全视觉概念的出现。 模型编辑方法通过修改生成参数来消除不需要的概念，具体方式包括微调 U-Net（Kumari 等，2023；Li 等，2024b；Kim 等，2024；Lyu 等，2024；Liu 等，2025），或优化交叉注意力层以实现局部化、可扩展的概念移除（Gandikota 等，2023；Gandikota 等，2024；Lu 等，2024；Huang 等，2024；Fan 等，2024）。 近期研究针对此类方法的残余弱点展开探索：被移除概念与其语义邻域之间的纠缠（Shi 等，2026）、纯文本侧监督的不精确性（Li 等，2026；Vardhana 和 Biswas，2026），以及在对抗性提示下被移除概念的恢复（Tsai 等，2024；Yin 等，2025）。 尽管这些方法有效，但它们可能会过度抑制相关但无害的概念，并且通常需要对每个新移除的概念进行重新训练或单独微调，从而限制了可扩展性。 相比之下，推理引导技术通过调整采样过程而不改变模型权重来规避不安全激活状态，其手段包括利用潜在空间方向（Li 等，2024a）或无分类器引导机制（Schramowski 等，2023）。 这类方法轻量且可逆，但通常对模糊提示的鲁棒性较差，可控性也有限。 与这些针对生成器的干预措施不同，我们在扩散过程的上游进行操作，即通过调整用于条件生成的编码器来实现目标。 因此，所得编码器可以在依赖相同 CLIP 背骨的兼容下游系统中重复使用，而无需修改其解码器。

paragraphs.en: Pre-Decoding Methods. These methods intervene before image generation by sanitizing or aligning latent embeddings. For example, Latent Guard ( Liu et al., 2024b ) filters harmful text representations, while Embedding Sanitizer ( Qiu et al., 2024 ) improves robustness through optimization or preference learning, and DES ( Ahn and Jung, 2025 ) and SafeText ( Hu et al., 2025b ) fine-tune the text encoder so that unsafe prompts are displaced while safe ones remain in place. PromptGuard ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) instead prepends a learned soft prompt, moderating unsafe generations without updating model weights. In our previous work, Safe-CLIP ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) , we extended this idea to multimodal encoders, aligning safe and unsafe image-text pairs to weaken unsafe associations.
paragraphs.zh: 预解码方法。 这些方法在图像生成之前进行干预，通过净化或对齐潜在嵌入来实现。 例如，Latent Guard（Liu 等人，2024b）会过滤有害的文本表示，而 Embedding Sanitizer（Qiu 等人，2024）则通过优化或偏好学习来提升鲁棒性；DES（Ahn 和 Jung，2025）以及 SafeText（Hu 等人，2025b）则会微调文本编码器，使不安全的提示被排除，而安全的提示则保留原处。 PromptGuard（Yuan 等人，2026）则通过添加一个经过学习的软提示来调节不安全的生成结果，而无需更新模型权重。 在我们之前的工作中，Safe-CLIP（Poppi 等人，2024）将这一思路扩展到了多模态编码器中，通过对齐安全与不安全图像-文本对来削弱不安全关联。

sents.zh: PromptGuard（Yuan 等人，2026）则通过添加一个经过学习的软提示来调节不安全的生成结果，而无需更新模型权重。

sents.en: In our previous work, Safe-CLIP ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) , we extended this idea to multimodal encoders, aligning safe and unsafe image-text pairs to weaken unsafe associations.
sents.zh: 在我们之前的工作中，Safe-CLIP（Poppi 等人，2024）将这一思路扩展到了多模态编码器中，通过对齐安全与不安全图像-文本对来削弱不安全关联。

paragraphs.en: Two recent works refine this encoder-level formulation. HySAC ( Poppi et al., 2025 ) abandons the flat embedding geometry, organizing safe and unsafe content in a hyperbolic hierarchy that queries can traverse toward safe regions, while SafeR-CLIP ( Yousaf et al., 2026a ) keeps each unsafe concept close to its nearest safe alternative, recovering zero-shot accuracy lost to more aggressive redirection. Both govern where unsafe content is sent. ShieldCLIP retains this pre-decoding, encoder-level formulation but instead governs what is redirected: generated items are labeled separately by modality, preservation is applied to generated-safe content, and redirection is restricted to the modalities labeled unsafe. Differently from our previous version, which assigns a single safety state to each generated pair, supervision here follows the observed content of each modality rather than its origin.
paragraphs.zh: 最近的两项工作对这种编码器层面的表述进行了改进。 HySAC（Poppi 等人，2025）摒弃了平坦的嵌入几何结构，将安全与不安全的内容组织成一种双曲层级结构，使查询能够沿着该结构向安全区域移动；而 SafeR-CLIP（Yousaf 等人，2026a）则让每个不安全概念都靠近其最近的安全替代项，从而恢复了因更激进的重新定向而损失的零样本准确率。 两者都控制着不安全内容被发送的位置。 ShieldCLIP 保留了这种解码前、编码器层面的表述，但转而控制的是哪些内容需要被重新定向：生成的项目按模态分别标记，对生成后的安全内容应用保留机制，而重新定向则仅限于被标记为不安全的模态。 与我们之前的版本不同——后者为每对生成项分配单一的安全状态——此处的监督依据的是每种模态的观测内容，而非其来源。

paragraphs.en: Existing datasets for harmful content mitigation mainly focus on text-only benchmarks or prompt-based red-teaming, offering limited multimodal coverage and weak safe-unsafe correspondence. I2P ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ) collects 4.7k real-world web prompts using NSFW-related keywords to evaluate unsafe generations, while SneakyPrompt ( Yang et al., 2024b ) provides ∼ \sim 200 jailbreak prompts crafted with ChatGPT to elicit explicit content. Ring-A-Bell ( Tsai et al., 2024 ) extends this line with subsets of NSFW, safe, and inverse prompts targeting nudity and violence, though many prompts are syntactically noisy and narrow. Similarly, MMA-Diffusion ( Yang et al., 2024a ) introduces explicit NSFW prompts along with adversarial, sanitized, and safe variants, but lacks one-to-one safe-unsafe pairing and contains many ungrammatical prompts. CoPro ( Liu et al., 2024b ) instead offers structured textual pairs from 578 harmful concepts and their benign replacements, yet remains text-only and limited in size.
paragraphs.zh: 现有用于有害内容缓解的数据集主要聚焦于纯文本基准或基于提示的“红队测试”，其多模态覆盖范围有限，且安全与不安全内容之间的对应关系较弱。 I2P（Schramowski 等人，2023）使用与 NSFW 相关的关键词收集了 4.7k 条真实网络提示，以评估不安全生成；而 SneakyPrompt（Yang 等人，2024b）则提供了约 \sim 200 条通过 ChatGPT 设计的越狱提示，用于诱导生成露骨内容。 Ring-A-Bell（Tsai 等人，2024）在此基础上扩展了 NSFW、安全及反向提示的子集，分别针对裸露和暴力内容，但许多提示在语法上存在噪声且范围较窄。 类似地，MMA-Diffusion（Yang 等人，2024a）引入了明确的 NSFW 提示及其对抗性、净化版和安全变体，但缺乏一对一的安全-不安全配对，并包含大量不合语法的提示。 CoPro（Liu 等人，2024b）则提供了来自 578 个有害概念与其良性替代项的结构化文本对，但仍局限于纯文本形式且规模有限。

paragraphs.en: A second group assembles multimodal material. ToViLaG ( Wang et al., 2023 ) collects toxic image-text pairs, MM-SafetyBench ( Liu et al., 2024c ) and VLSBench ( Hu et al., 2025a ) probe multimodal language models with paired visual and textual queries, and UnsafeBench ( Qu et al., 2025 ) evaluates image safety classifiers on both real and generated images. Closer to our setting, CoProV2 ( Liu et al., 2025 ) scales concept-level prompts into preference data for alignment, and NSFW-Caps ( Yousaf et al., 2026a ) contributes 1k aligned image-text pairs for measuring safety under distributional shift.
paragraphs.zh: 第二组收集多模态材料。 ToViLaG（Wang 等，2023）收集有毒的图像-文本对；MM-SafetyBench（Liu 等，2024c）和 VLSBench（Hu 等，2025a）通过成对的视觉和文本查询来测试多模态语言模型；而 UnsafeBench（Qu 等，2025）则在真实图像和生成图像上评估图像安全分类器。 更贴近我们设定的是 CoProV2（Liu 等，2025），它将概念级别的提示扩展为用于对齐的偏好数据；NSFW-Caps（Yousaf 等，2026a）则贡献了 1000 个经过对齐的图像-文本对，用于衡量分布偏移下的安全性。

paragraphs.en: While these datasets enable concept-level safety evaluation, they carry a single safety label per sample or prompt, and none offers aligned multimodal pairs with modality-specific annotations. ViSU ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) partially bridges this gap by pairing safe image-text samples with generated counterparts, but it treats all generated data as unsafe and uses a 20-category taxonomy. In contrast to all these resources, ViSUv2 preserves the paired real-generated design of ViSU while annotating each generated modality independently, over a taxonomy expanded to 28 categories and with more recent generators. This is the annotation that makes selective, modality-aware optimization possible in the first place.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管这些数据集支持概念层面的安全性评估，但每个样本或提示仅附带一个安全标签，且没有任何数据集提供与特定模态标注对齐的多模态配对数据。 ViSU（Poppi 等人，2024）通过将安全的图像-文本样本与其生成的对应样本配对，部分填补了这一空白，但它将所有生成数据视为不安全，并采用了一个包含 20 个类别的分类体系。 与所有这些资源不同，ViSUv2 保留了 ViSU 的“真实-生成”配对设计，同时为每个生成的模态独立添加标注，其分类体系已扩展至 28 个类别，并采用了更新型号的生成器。 正是这种标注方式，才使得选择性的、具备模态感知的优化成为可能。

paragraphs.en: Scope. We study safety alignment for CLIP-like multimodal encoders, used as core components for retrieval, captioning, and text-to-image generation pipelines. Our objective is twofold: (i) suppress harmful signals in text and images and (ii) preserve benign semantics so that downstream systems relying on the original CLIP features remain compatible. Because a closed definition of “safety” is infeasible, we operate, like prior work ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024b ; Poppi et al., 2024 ; Poppi et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Gandikota et al., 2023 ) , over a taxonomy of concept proxies.
paragraphs.zh: 范围。 我们研究类似 CLIP 的多模态编码器的安全对齐问题，这些编码器被用作检索、图像描述和文本到图像生成流程的核心组件。 我们的目标有两个：（i）抑制文本和图像中的有害信号，以及（ii）保留无害的语义，以确保依赖原始 CLIP 特征的下游系统仍能保持兼容性。 由于无法为“安全性”给出一个封闭的定义，因此我们像先前的研究（Schramowski 等人，2023；Liu 等人，2024b；Poppi 等人，2024；Poppi 等人，2025；Liu 等人，2025；Gandikota 等人，2023）一样，基于一个概念代理的分类体系开展工作。

paragraphs.en: Taxonomy. Prior safety-aligned methods typically rely on a 20-class harmful content taxonomy ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ; Poppi et al., 2024 ) . To better capture the diversity of unsafe content, we expand this taxonomy to 28 categories, guided by the 578 fine-grained NSFW concepts released by CoPro ( Liu et al., 2024b ) , which we use to both drive content generation and structure the taxonomy. Each concept is automatically mapped by an LLM ( i.e. , LLaMA-3.1-8B ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) ) into one or more categories, creating a many-to-many mapping that better reflects the multifaceted nature of unsafe content: for example, the concept rape is assigned to the sexual , violence , and abuse categories. Concepts thus drive sample generation, while categories enable higher-level analysis and evaluation. Further details regarding the prompt used to classify the CoPro concepts into the ViSUv2 categories are provided in Appendix 6.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 分类体系。 以往与安全性对齐的方法通常依赖一个包含 20 个类别的有害内容分类体系（Schramowski 等人，2023；Poppi 等人，2024）。 为了更好地捕捉不安全内容的多样性，我们在 CoPro（Liu 等人，2024b）发布的 578 个细粒度 NSFW 概念指导下，将该分类体系扩展至 28 个类别，并用这些概念来驱动内容生成和构建分类体系的结构。 每个概念都由一个大语言模型（LLM）（即 LLaMA-3.1-8B（Grattafiori 等人，2024））自动映射到一个或多个类别中，从而形成一种多对多的映射关系，更准确地反映了不安全内容的多面性：例如，“强奸”这一概念被分配到了“性”“暴力”和“虐待”等类别中。 因此，概念用于驱动样本生成，而类别则支持更高层级的分析与评估。 关于将 CoPro 概念分类到 ViSUv2 类别所使用的提示词，更多细节见附录 6.4。

paragraphs.en: To identify the categories missing from the original 20 ViSU classes ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) ( i.e. , hate, harassment, violence, suffering, humiliation, harm, suicide, sexual, nudity, bodily fluids, blood, obscene gestures, illegal activity, drug use, theft, vandalism, weapons, abuse, brutality, and cruelty ), we encode all ViSU categories to obtain a category list A A , and encode all CoPro concepts to obtain a concept list B B , using CLIP-ViT-L/14 to generate semantic embeddings. The concepts in B B are then clustered into 30 groups, and for each ViSU category a ∈ A a\in A , we compute the pairwise cosine distance between a a and each CoPro cluster, selecting the 8 CoPro clusters that are farthest away from the set A A – i.e. , the concepts not already represented in the original taxonomy.
paragraphs.zh: 为了识别原始 20 个 ViSU 类别（Poppi 等人，2024）中缺失的类别（即仇恨、骚扰、暴力、痛苦、羞辱、伤害、自杀、性内容、裸体、体液、血液、不雅手势、非法活动、吸毒、盗窃、破坏公物、武器、虐待、暴行和残酷），我们使用 CLIP-ViT-L/14 生成语义嵌入，对所有的 ViSU 类别进行编码以获得类别列表 A A，并对所有的 CoPro 概念进行编码以获得概念列表 B B。 随后，将 B B 中的概念聚类为 30 个组，对于每个 ViSU 类别 a ∈ A，我们计算 a 与每个 CoPro 簇之间的成对余弦距离，并选择距离集合 A A 最远的 8 个 CoPro 簇——即原始分类体系中尚未被表示的概念。

paragraphs.en: To assign a general denomination to each of these new clusters, we examine the members of the cluster (drawn from B B ) and consult ChatGPT for assistance in producing concise, descriptive labels. We then expand A A with these newly identified and named categories; for example, the cluster containing the concepts transphobia, ladyboy, asexual freak, homophobia, biphobia, LGBTQ+ individuals is assigned the category name “ discrimination ”.
paragraphs.zh: 为了为这些新聚类中的每一个分配一个通用名称，我们会检查聚类中的成员（从 B B 中选取），并咨询 ChatGPT，以协助生成简洁且具描述性的标签。 接着，我们将这些新识别并命名的类别添加到 A A 中；例如，包含跨性别恐惧、人妖、无性恋怪胎、同性恋恐惧、双性恋恐惧以及 LGBTQ+ 个体等概念的聚类被赋予“歧视”这一类别名称。

paragraphs.zh: 该过程共产生了 28 个类别：仇恨、骚扰、暴力、痛苦、羞辱、伤害、自杀、性相关、裸体、体液、血液、不雅手势、非法活动、吸毒、盗窃、破坏公物、武器、虐待、残暴、残酷、歧视、极端意识形态、侮辱性言论、身材羞辱、心理健康问题、令人震惊的内容、粗俗幽默和药物滥用。 图 3 展示了由此产生的概念到类别的映射示例。

paragraphs.en: Text Generation. We generate captions intended to express unsafe concepts starting from safe ones by applying a corruption strategy that preserves semantic context. Specifically, given a safe caption t i t_{i} , we prompt LLaMA-3.1-8B ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) with an output prefilling attack technique ( Cappelletti et al., 2026 ) to rewrite it into an unsafe variant t ¯ i \bar{t}_{i} by conditioning on a sampled NSFW concept. To balance semantic relevance and coverage, we first compute CLIP similarities between t i t_{i} and the 578 candidate concepts. We retain the 50 most similar concepts and uniformly sample one to guide the rewriting. The LLM is then instructed to explicitly incorporate the sampled NSFW concept into the rewrite, ensuring that unsafe variants remain aligned with the underlying scene while differing in safety level. Each generated caption is then automatically classified as safe or unsafe using LLaMA-3.1-8B with a prefilling-based classification prompt ( Cappelletti et al., 2026 ) , and its underlying concept(s) are mapped to the 28 categories, enabling consistent safety labels and category-level analysis. Further generation and classification details are reported in Appendix 6 .
paragraphs.zh: 文本生成。 我们通过应用一种保留语义语境的扰动策略，从安全的描述出发，生成旨在表达不安全概念的文本。 具体而言，给定一个安全的描述 t i t_{i} ，我们使用输出预填充攻击技术（Cappelletti et al., 2026）提示 LLaMA-3.1-8B（Grattafiori et al., 2024），通过基于采样得到的 NSFW 概念进行条件约束，将其改写为不安全变体 t ¯ i \bar{t}_{i} 。 为了在语义相关性和覆盖范围之间取得平衡，我们首先计算 t i t_{i} 与 578 个候选概念之间的 CLIP 相似度。 我们保留最相似的 50 个概念，并从中均匀采样一个以指导改写过程。 随后，我们指示 LLM 明确将采样得到的 NSFW 概念融入改写结果中，确保不安全变体在安全级别不同的同时，仍与原始场景保持一致。 接着，每个生成的描述都通过 LLaMA-3.1-8B 和基于预填充的分类提示（Cappelletti et al., 2026）被自动分类为安全或不安全，其底层概念也被映射到 28 个类别中，从而实现一致的安全标签和类别级分析。 更多生成与分类的细节在附录 6 中报告。

paragraphs.en: Image Generation. For each generated caption t ¯ i \bar{t}_{i} , we generate the corresponding image with one of two distinct text-to-image diffusion models, selected based on the caption. Specifically, we employ NewRealityXL 1 1 1 stablediffusionapi/newrealityxl-global-nsfw , a Stable Diffusion XL ( Podell et al., 2024 ) variant fine-tuned for NSFW generation, and an uncensored variant 2 2 2 lustlyai/Flux_Lustly.ai_Uncensored_nsfw_v1 of FLUX ( Black Forest Labs, 2024 ) . The two models exhibit complementary strengths: FLUX tends to generate more explicit depictions when nudity is implied, whereas SDXL produces more semantically coherent scenes for other unsafe content ( e.g. violence or suffering). To leverage this complementarity, we employ a classifier based on LLaMA-3.1-8B to predict whether the caption implies nudity. If present, the image is generated with FLUX; otherwise, with SDXL.
paragraphs.zh: 图像生成。 对于每个生成的标题 t ¯ i \bar{t}_{i}，我们使用两种不同的文本到图像扩散模型之一生成对应的图像，具体选择依据该标题而定。 具体来说，我们采用了 NewRealityXL 1 1 1 stablediffusionapi/newrealityxl-global-nsfw（一个针对 NSFW 内容生成的、基于 Stable Diffusion XL（Podell 等人，2024）的变体），以及 FLUX（Black Forest Labs，2024）的一个未审查版本 2 2 2 lustlyai/Flux_Lustly.ai_Uncensored_nsfw_v1。 这两种模型展现出互补的优势：当标题暗示裸体时，FLUX 倾向于生成更露骨的描绘；而对于其他不安全内容（例如暴力或痛苦），SDXL 则能生成更具语义连贯性的场景。 为了利用这种互补性，我们采用了一个基于 LLaMA-3.1-8B 的分类器，以预测标题是否暗示了裸体。 如果存在裸体暗示，则使用 FLUX 生成图像；否则，使用 SDXL 生成。

sents.zh: 如果存在裸体暗示，则使用 FLUX 生成图像；否则，使用 SDXL 生成。

paragraphs.en: All generated images are automatically labeled as safe or unsafe by combining two complementary classifiers: NudeNet ( Bedapudi, 2019 ) , which detects nudity and exposed features, and Q16 ( Schramowski et al., 2022 ) , which captures broader unsafe visual cues such as violence or disturbing visual content. An image is labeled unsafe if either classifier predicts NSFW, and safe only when both agree. The classifiers are used only to assign binary modality-level safety labels during dataset construction; their scores, representations, or gradients are never used in the training objective. This procedure yields a dataset of real and generated multimodal pairs with independent safety labels for both captions and images 3 3 3 We validate the automated modality-level safety labels in a human study on 1,000 generated pairs, obtaining 86% and 81% agreement for text and image labels, respectively. Additional details are reported in Appendix 6.3 . .
paragraphs.zh: 所有生成的图像都通过结合两种互补的分类器自动标记为安全或不安全：NudeNet（Bedapudi，2019），用于检测裸体暴露和暴露特征；以及 Q16（Schramowski 等，2022），用于捕捉更广泛的不安全视觉线索，例如暴力或令人不安的视觉内容。 如果任一分类器预测图像为 NSFW，则该图像被标记为不安全；仅当两者结果一致时，才标记为安全。 在数据集构建过程中，这些分类器仅用于分配二元的模态级安全标签；它们的分数、表示或梯度绝不会用于训练目标。 该流程生成一个包含真实和生成的多模态配对的数据集，其中文本和图像均有独立的安全标签。3 3 3 我们通过一项涉及 1,000 个生成配对的人类研究，验证了自动化的模态级安全标签，结果显示文本和图像标签的准确率分别达到 86% 和 81%。 更多细节报告见附录 6.3。

paragraphs.en: Key Idea. ShieldCLIP conditions its training objectives on the observed safety state of each modality rather than the origin of a sample, combining preservation and redirection under modality-specific supervision. It activates these objectives conditionally to (i) preserve real samples and generated-safe samples, avoiding over-sanitization and retaining compatibility with 𝒯 0 , 𝒱 0 \mathcal{T}_{0},\mathcal{V}_{0} , and (ii) redirect generated-unsafe samples toward their safe counterparts without perturbing unrelated regions of the embedding space. Additional objectives handle mixed pairs and maintain cross-modal coherence when both generated modalities are unsafe. An overview is shown in Fig. 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 核心思想。 ShieldCLIP 将其训练目标的条件建立在每种模态所观察到的安全状态上，而非样本的来源，从而在模态特定的监督下结合保留与重定向。 它会根据条件激活这些目标：(i) 保留真实样本和生成安全的样本，避免过度净化并维持与 𝒯 0 , 𝒱 0 \mathcal{T}_{0},\mathcal{V}_{0} 的兼容性；以及 (ii) 将生成不安全的样本重定向至其安全对应版本，同时不对嵌入空间中无关的区域造成扰动。 附加目标用于处理混合配对，并在两种生成的模态均不安全时维持跨模态一致性。 概述见图 4。

paragraphs.en: Overall, conditioning preservation and redirection on the observed safety state of each modality, rather than on the origin of a sample, lets ShieldCLIP treat generation and harmfulness as independent: safe content is anchored regardless of whether it is real or generated, unsafe content is redirected only where it is actually unsafe, and mixed and jointly-unsafe pairs are handled by dedicated terms instead of being collapsed into a single pair-level label. This finer-grained supervision reduces over-sanitization of benign generated content while still suppressing harmful associations, and it keeps the resulting encoders compatible with downstream systems built on the original CLIP embedding space. We evaluate these benefits next, on cross-modal retrieval and on the downstream generative systems that consume CLIP embeddings.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，根据每种模态所观察到的安全状态而非样本来源来调节保留与重定向，使得 ShieldCLIP 能够将生成性与有害性视为独立因素：无论内容是真实的还是生成的，只要其安全，就会得到锚定；只有当内容确实不安全时才会被重定向；而对于混合或同时不安全的组合，则由专门的术语处理，而不是将其合并为单一的对级别标签。 这种更精细的监督机制减少了良性生成内容的过度净化，同时仍然抑制有害关联，并确保最终的编码器与基于原始 CLIP 嵌入空间构建的下游系统保持兼容。 接下来，我们将在跨模态检索以及使用 CLIP 嵌入的下游生成系统中评估这些优势。

paragraphs.en: Dataset Splits. To construct the ViSUv2 dataset, real samples are drawn from COCO ( Lin et al., 2014 ) and Flickr30k ( Young et al., 2014 ) , two complementary datasets of natural images annotated with human-written descriptions. For each image, we randomly select one of the five available captions to reduce redundancy and avoid excessive semantic overlap across samples while maintaining linguistic variety.
paragraphs.zh: 数据集划分。 为了构建 ViSUv2 数据集，我们从 COCO（Lin et al., 2014）和 Flickr30k（Young et al., 2014）中抽取真实样本；这两个数据集互为补充，均包含带有手写描述的自然图像。 对于每张图像，我们随机选择五个可用描述中的一个，以减少冗余、避免样本间过度的语义重叠，同时保持语言多样性。

sents.en: Dataset Splits.
sents.zh: 数据集划分。

sents.en: To construct the ViSUv2 dataset, real samples are drawn from COCO ( Lin et al., 2014 ) and Flickr30k ( Young et al., 2014 ) , two complementary datasets of natural images annotated with human-written descriptions.
sents.zh: 为了构建 ViSUv2 数据集，我们从 COCO（Lin et al., 2014）和 Flickr30k（Young et al., 2014）中抽取真实样本；这两个数据集互为补充，均包含带有手写描述的自然图像。

sents.en: For each image, we randomly select one of the five available captions to reduce redundancy and avoid excessive semantic overlap across samples while maintaining linguistic variety.
sents.zh: 对于每张图像，我们随机选择五个可用描述中的一个，以减少冗余、避免样本间过度的语义重叠，同时保持语言多样性。

paragraphs.en: Overall, ViSUv2 contains 195k text-image quadruplets, of which 30k are derived from Flickr30k and 165k from COCO. We use 8,000 quadruplets for testing, 8,000 for validation, and the remaining 179,000 for training. No COCO or Flickr30k image appears in more than one split.

paragraphs.en: Implementation and Training Details. We fine-tune two distinct CLIP backbone models: ViT-L-14 (corresponding to the text encoder used in Stable Diffusion v1.4) and ViT-bigG/14 (the other text encoder in Stable Diffusion XL). For parameter-efficient fine-tuning, we apply LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) to all Transformer layers of both the text and vision encoders with a rank r r equal to 16. All parameters of the original oracle encoders ( 𝒯 0 \mathcal{T}_{0} , 𝒱 0 \mathcal{V}_{0} ) remain frozen during training. Both models are trained using the Adam optimizer with a constant learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} . We train for a maximum of 50 epochs and employ early stopping based on recall, with a patience of 5 epochs. The model based on ViT-L/14 is trained on 8 A100 GPUs with a per-GPU batch size of 16 and no gradient accumulation, while the model based on ViT-bigG is trained on 16 GPUs with a per-GPU batch size of 8 and 2 gradient accumulation steps. The 𝝀 \bm{\lambda} weights defined in Eq. 10 are set to (0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.25, 0.25), where 𝝀 = ( λ real , λ safe , λ redir , λ mix , λ coh ) \bm{\lambda}=(\lambda_{\mathrm{real}},\lambda_{\mathrm{safe}},\lambda_{\mathrm{redir}},\lambda_{\mathrm{mix}},\lambda_{\mathrm{coh}}) .

paragraphs.en: Table 1 compares ViSUv2 with existing safety datasets, including text-only resources ( i.e. , SneakyPrompt ( Yang et al., 2024b ) , Ring-A-Bell ( Tsai et al., 2024 ) , and I2P ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ) ) and multimodal ones ( i.e. , MMA-Diffusion ( Yang et al., 2024a ) and ViSU ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) ). The evaluation focuses on two key dimensions: diversity , reflecting how varied the text or images are within each dataset, and harmfulness , indicating how reliably unsafe content is captured. For text, diversity is measured with the Vendi-Score (from CLIP textual embeddings) ( Friedman and Dieng, 2023 ) , which quantifies the entropy of semantic similarities across samples, where higher values indicate greater diversity, and Self-BLEU ( Perez et al., 2022 ) , which measures sentence redundancy (lower values indicate higher diversity). Text harmfulness is estimated via LLM-based classification using GPT-3.5 Turbo ( Brown et al., 2020 ) , prompted to flag unsafe content. For images, diversity is computed using the same Vendi-Score formulation on CLIP visual embeddings, while harmfulness is evaluated through GPT-4 ( Achiam et al., 2023 ) . Additionally, we report the proportion of harmful items detected by the classifiers used during the dataset safety labeling stage (LLaMA-3.1-8B ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) and the NudeNet ( Bedapudi, 2019 ) -Q16 ( Schramowski et al., 2022 ) ensemble), shown for reference to facilitate comparison across datasets. All scores are computed on items containing unsafe content, using the test splits of each dataset when available. Further details on the harmfulness and diversity evaluation protocols are provided in Appendix 7.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 表1将ViSUv2与现有的安全数据集进行了比较，包括纯文本资源（即SneakyPrompt（Yang等，2024b）、Ring-A-Bell（Tsai等，2024）和I2P（Schramowski等，2023））以及多模态资源（即MMA-Diffusion（Yang等，2024a）和ViSU（Poppi等，2024））。 评估重点关注两个关键维度：多样性，反映每个数据集中文本或图像的差异程度；以及有害性，表示不安全内容被捕捉的可靠性。 对于文本，多样性通过Vendi-Score（来自CLIP文本嵌入）（Friedman和Dieng，2023）进行衡量，该指标量化了样本间语义相似性的熵值，数值越高表示多样性越强；同时使用Self-BLEU（Perez等，2022）衡量句子冗余度（数值越低表示多样性越强）。 文本的有害性通过基于LLM的分类方法进行评估，具体使用GPT-3.5 Turbo（Brown等，2020），并提示其标记不安全内容。 对于图像，多样性使用相同的Vendi-Score公式在CLIP视觉嵌入上计算，而有害性则通过GPT-4（Achiam等，2023）进行评估。 此外，我们还报告了数据集安全标注阶段所用分类器（LLaMA-3.1-8B（Grattafiori等，2024）和NudeNet（Bedapudi，2019）-Q16（Schramowski等，2022）集成）检测到的有害项比例，该数据作为参考以方便跨数据集比较。 所有评分均基于包含不安全内容的项计算，并在各数据集可用的测试分割集上进行。 关于有害性和多样性评估协议的更多细节见附录7.2。

paragraphs.en: Overall, ViSUv2 achieves the most balanced performance across all dimensions, combining high semantic diversity with accurate and consistent safety labeling. It attains the lowest Self-BLEU and strong Vendi-Score values across multimodal datasets, indicating diverse yet coherent unsafe captions, while exhibiting the highest proportion of harmful text. On the visual side, ViSUv2 shows the greatest image diversity and the highest level of harmfulness among generated images, consistently surpassing ViSU and MMA-Diffusion. These results show that ViSUv2 provides a rich and well-calibrated source of unsafe content while maintaining clear distinctions between safe and unsafe modalities.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，ViSUv2 在所有维度上实现了最均衡的性能，既具备高度的语义多样性，又能生成准确且一致的安全标签。 它在多模态数据集上获得了最低的 Self-BLEU 和较高的 Vendi-Score 值，表明其生成的不安全描述既多样化又具连贯性，同时有害文本的比例也最高。 在视觉层面，ViSUv2 生成的图像展现出最大的多样性以及最高的有害程度，持续优于 ViSU 和 MMA-Diffusion。 这些结果表明，ViSUv2 能够提供一个丰富且经过良好校准的不安全内容来源，同时保持安全与不安全模态之间的清晰区分。

paragraphs.en: Main Results. We evaluate ShieldCLIP as the text encoder in text-to-image diffusion models, measuring the proportion of harmful generations across multiple NSFW prompt sources. Experiments are conducted with both SD v1.4 ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) and SDXL ( Podell et al., 2024 ) , applying our mitigation strategy to the CLIP text encoders used by each model. Each prompt is sampled five times with different random seeds, and generated images are classified using the combined NudeNet and Q16 classifiers ( Bedapudi, 2019 ; Schramowski et al., 2022 ) . Table 2 reports results on I2P ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ) , using the entire set of prompts available in the dataset, and on the NSFW subset of the ViSUv2 test split, covering a broad range of unsafe categories. For each dataset, we compute the average violation rate across categories 4 4 4 Appendix 7.1 reports the mapping from our 28 categories to the seven groups commonly used in prior work. , averaging per prompt over the five generations. We compare ShieldCLIP against generator-side mitigation approaches based on inference-time guidance or model editing ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ; Gandikota et al., 2023 ; Gandikota et al., 2024 ; Lyu et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , as well as pre-decoding methods that operate on the conditioning representations, including Embedding Sanitizer ( Qiu et al., 2024 ) , DES ( Ahn and Jung, 2025 ) 5 5 5 To evaluate DES ( Ahn and Jung, 2025 ) with SDXL, we use the checkpoints released by the authors: the multiple NSFW concepts checkpoint for the CLIP ViT-L/14 text encoder and the sexual checkpoint for the CLIP ViT-G/14 text encoder. The latter is the only checkpoint provided for the ViT-G backbone. , Safe-CLIP ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) , and SafeR-CLIP ( Yousaf et al., 2026a ) .

paragraphs.en: Across both diffusion backbones and datasets, ShieldCLIP achieves the lowest average harmful generation rate. On SD v1.4, it reduces harmful generations from 38.1% to 3.5% on I2P and from 25.4% to 1.0% on ViSUv2. Compared with our previous Safe-CLIP ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) , this corresponds to a substantial reduction from 21.8% and 6.1%, respectively. paragraphs.en: These gains also extend beyond the two main evaluation benchmarks. To probe robustness across different NSFW prompt distributions, Table 4.3 reports results on four additional sources: ViSU ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) , SneakyPrompt ( Yang et al., 2024b ) , MMA ( Yang et al., 2024a ) , and Ring-A-Bell ( Tsai et al., 2024 ) , including adversarial and implicitly unsafe prompts designed to bypass safety mechanisms. These results consistently improve over Safe-CLIP and SafeR-CLIP, while remaining competitive with strong baselines such as SafetyDPO and DES. paragraphs.en: Evaluation with an Alternative Safety Classifier. Since NudeNet and Q16 are used to assign image-level safety labels during ViSUv2 construction, we additionally evaluate all generated images with LlavaGuard ( Helff et al., 2025 ) , which is not used during dataset construction or training. Unlike the NudeNet-Q16 ensemble, LlavaGuard is a multimodal LLM-based moderation model that reasons over visual content according to a textual safety policy, providing a substantially different evaluation mechanism. This experiment therefore directly tests whether the gains of ShieldCLIP persist under a safety evaluator disjoint from the labeling pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 使用替代安全分类器进行评估。 由于 NudeNet 和 Q16 在构建 ViSUv2 期间被用于分配图像级别的安全标签，我们还使用 LlavaGuard（Helff 等人，2025）对所有生成的图像进行了额外评估；该模型在数据集构建或训练过程中并未使用。 与 NudeNet-Q16 集成模型不同，LlavaGuard 是一种基于多模态大语言模型的审核模型，它能根据文本安全策略对视觉内容进行推理，从而提供了一种截然不同的评估机制。 因此，本实验直接检验了：在采用与标签生成流程完全分离的安全评估器时，ShieldCLIP 的性能提升是否依然有效。

paragraphs.en: Overall, LlavaGuard closely reproduces the trends observed with NudeNet-Q16 on both the main benchmarks and the additional prompt sources. Since LlavaGuard is not used for dataset labeling or training, these consistent gains show that the improvements of ShieldCLIP are not specific to the safety classifiers used to construct ViSUv2, but reflect robust reductions in harmful generation.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，LlavaGuard 在主基准测试和额外提示源上都高度复现了 NudeNet-Q16 所观察到的趋势。 由于 LlavaGuard 并未用于数据集的标注或训练，这些一致的提升表明 ShieldCLIP 的改进并非仅限于构建 ViSUv2 时使用的安全分类器，而是反映了有害生成内容得到了可靠的减少。

sents.en: Overall, LlavaGuard closely reproduces the trends observed with NudeNet-Q16 on both the main benchmarks and the additional prompt sources.
sents.zh: 总体而言，LlavaGuard 在主基准测试和额外提示源上都高度复现了 NudeNet-Q16 所观察到的趋势。

sents.en: Since LlavaGuard is not used for dataset labeling or training, these consistent gains show that the improvements of ShieldCLIP are not specific to the safety classifiers used to construct ViSUv2, but reflect robust reductions in harmful generation.
sents.zh: 由于 LlavaGuard 并未用于数据集的标注或训练，这些一致的提升表明 ShieldCLIP 的改进并非仅限于构建 ViSUv2 时使用的安全分类器，而是反映了有害生成内容得到了可靠的减少。

paragraphs.en: Human Evaluation. To complement the automated evaluation, we conduct a human preference study with 20 independent annotators. We collect 1,200 pairwise evaluations from prompts randomly sampled from the ViSUv2 test set, balanced equally across the three competing methods (400 comparisons each): Safe-CLIP ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) , SafeR-CLIP ( Yousaf et al., 2026a ) , and SafetyDPO ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . Each comparison presents ShieldCLIP alongside one competitor, with method identities hidden and left/right order randomized.
paragraphs.zh: 人类评估。 为了补充自动化评估，我们开展了一项人类偏好研究，邀请了 20 名独立标注者参与。 我们从 ViSUv2 测试集中随机抽取的提示词中收集了 1,200 组成对评估结果，并在三种对比方法之间均匀分配（每种方法各 400 组比较）：Safe-CLIP (Poppi et al., 2024)、SafeR-CLIP (Yousaf et al., 2026a) 和 SafetyDPO (Liu et al., 2025)。 每组比较都将 ShieldCLIP 与其中一种对比方法一同呈现，同时隐藏方法名称并随机调整左右顺序。

paragraphs.en: Annotators evaluate each pair according to two criteria: safety , indicating which image better avoids harmful or inappropriate content, and content preservation , indicating which image better preserves the semantics of the original prompt while remaining safe. For each criterion, annotators can prefer either image or indicate a tie when neither output is clearly preferred. To obtain a single preference score for each method, ties are split equally between the two models. Table 4.3 reports the resulting percentage of preference assigned to each competitor over ShieldCLIP. Across all three comparisons, ShieldCLIP is preferred by a clear majority for both criteria. These results complement the automated evaluation, confirming that our method produces outputs that are both safer and more faithful to the original prompts compared to existing approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 标注员根据两个标准对每对图像进行评估：安全性，即哪张图像能更好地避免有害或不适当的内容；以及内容保留性，即哪张图像在保持安全性的同时能更好地保留原始提示的语义。 对于每个标准，标注员可以选择偏好其中一张图像，或者在两张图像均无明显优势时判定为平局。 为了为每种方法获得单一偏好得分，平局的情况将平均分配给两个模型。 表 4.3 报告了各竞争方法相对于 ShieldCLIP 所获得的偏好百分比。 在所有三项比较中，ShieldCLIP 在两个标准上均获得了明显多数人的偏好。 这些结果补充了自动化评估，证实了我们的方法与现有方法相比，生成的输出既更安全，也更忠实于原始提示。

paragraphs.en: Table 4.4 reports the proportion of harmful text generated by multimodal LLMs when conditioned on unsafe visual inputs. We evaluate ShieldCLIP as the visual encoder within the LLaVA architecture ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024a ) , using the LLaMA-2-13B variant as the language backbone 6 6 6 We select this model because its visual encoder is compatible with ShieldCLIP trained for SD v1.4, based on CLIP ViT-L/14. Generated captions are classified as harmful by combining two LLM-based classifiers ( i.e. , LLaMA-3.1-8B and GPT-3.5 Turbo), marking a caption unsafe if either classifier flags it.

paragraphs.en: In this setting, we compare ShieldCLIP against the standard LLaVA baseline, equipped with the original CLIP visual encoder, and two safety-aligned multimodal encoders: our previous Safe-CLIP ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) and SafeR-CLIP ( Yousaf et al., 2026a ) . We evaluate 1,000 unsafe real images from each of three sources, covering sexual and nudity content ( i.e. , NudeNet ( Bedapudi, 2019 ) and NSFW data source URLs) as well as broader unsafe visual cues ( i.e. , SMID ( Crone et al., 2018 ) ).
paragraphs.zh: 在此设定中，我们将 ShieldCLIP 与标准的 LLaVA 基线模型进行比较。该基线模型配备了原始的 CLIP 视觉编码器，以及两种经过安全对齐的多模态编码器：我们之前提出的 Safe-CLIP（Poppi 等人，2024）和 SafeR-CLIP（Yousaf 等人，2026a）。 我们从三个来源中各评估了 1,000 张不安全的真实图像，这些图像涵盖了性内容和裸露内容（即 NudeNet（Bedapudi，2019）和 NSFW 数据源 URL），以及更广泛的不安全视觉线索（即 SMID（Crone 等人，2018））。

sents.zh: 我们从三个来源中各评估了 1,000 张不安全的真实图像，这些图像涵盖了性内容和裸露内容（即 NudeNet（Bedapudi，2019）和 NSFW 数据源 URL），以及更广泛的不安全视觉线索（即 SMID（Crone 等人，2018））。

paragraphs.en: Across all data sources, replacing the original visual encoder with ShieldCLIP substantially reduces harmful caption generation. On NudeNet and NSFW URLs, ShieldCLIP achieves the lowest harmful rates of 12.5% and 6.2%, improving over Safe-CLIP (14.6% and 7.5%) and SafeR-CLIP (17.4% and 10.2%). On SMID, all safety-aligned encoders perform similarly, with SafeR-CLIP obtaining the lowest rate (2.2%) and ShieldCLIP remaining close at 2.5%. Overall, these results show that the gains of ShieldCLIP extend beyond text-to-image generation to the image-to-text setting.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有数据源中，将原始视觉编码器替换为 ShieldCLIP 能够显著减少有害配文的生成。 在 NudeNet 和 NSFW URL 上，ShieldCLIP 的有害率最低，分别为 12.5% 和 6.2%，优于 Safe-CLIP（14.6% 和 7.5%）以及 SafeR-CLIP（17.4% 和 10.2%）。 在 SMID 上，所有与安全目标对齐的编码器表现相近，其中 SafeR-CLIP 的有害率最低（2.2%），而 ShieldCLIP 的有害率也接近，为 2.5%。 总体而言，这些结果表明，ShieldCLIP 的优势不仅体现在文本到图像生成中，也延伸至图像到文本的场景。

paragraphs.en: The qualitative examples in Fig. 6 further illustrate this behavior: ShieldCLIP suppresses explicit visual cues that lead the original LLaVA, and in some cases Safe-CLIP, to produce unsafe descriptions, while retaining the coarse semantic context depicted in the input image.
paragraphs.zh: 图 6 中的定性示例进一步说明了这种行为：ShieldCLIP 抑制了那些导致原始 LLaVA 以及某些情况下 Safe-CLIP 生成不安全描述的明确视觉线索，同时保留了输入图像中所描绘的粗略语义背景。

paragraphs.en: After assessing the harmful-content mitigation performance of ShieldCLIP when employed as either textual or visual encoders in multimodal generative pipelines, we next evaluate whether the aligned embedding space also improves safety in cross-modal retrieval. Table 4.5 compares ShieldCLIP with our previous Safe-CLIP formulation ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) , HySAC ( Poppi et al., 2025 ) , a hyperbolic safety-aware CLIP variant, and SafeR-CLIP ( Yousaf et al., 2026a ) , always including the base CLIP model as reference.
paragraphs.zh: 在评估了 ShieldCLIP 作为多模态生成流程中的文本编码器或视觉编码器时，其在有害内容缓解方面的性能之后，我们接下来评估其对齐的嵌入空间是否也能提升跨模态检索的安全性。 表 4.5 将 ShieldCLIP 与我们之前的 Safe-CLIP 方案（Poppi 等人，2024）、HySAC（Poppi 等人，2025）——一种双曲安全感知 CLIP 变体，以及 SafeR-CLIP（Yousaf 等人，2026a）进行了比较，并始终将基础 CLIP 模型作为参考。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate both text-to-image (T2I) and image-to-text (I2T) retrieval on ViSU ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) , ViSUv2, and the three unsafe image sources used before ( i.e. , NudeNet ( Bedapudi, 2019 ) , NSFW URLs, and SMID ( Crone et al., 2018 ) ), following the evaluation protocol defined in prior works ( Poppi et al., 2024 ; Poppi et al., 2025 ) . In both directions, an unsafe query retrieves from a mixed pool of safe and unsafe candidates, and we report the fraction of queries whose top-1 result is harmful. For ViSU and ViSUv2, we use their paired test splits; for ViSUv2, queries are restricted to samples where both generated modalities are unsafe. For the three image-only sources, we combine 1,000 unsafe images from each dataset with safe distractors from LAION-400M ( Schuhmann et al., 2022 ) , using unsafe ViSUv2 captions as T2I queries and the unsafe images themselves as I2T queries.
paragraphs.zh: 我们遵循先前研究（Poppi et al., 2024; Poppi et al., 2025）中定义的评价协议，在 ViSU (Poppi et al., 2024)、ViSUv2 以及之前使用的三种不安全图像来源（即 NudeNet (Bedapudi, 2019)、NSFW URL 和 SMID (Crone et al., 2018)）上，对文本到图像（T2I）和图像到文本（I2T）检索进行了评估。 在两个方向中，不安全查询均从安全与不安全候选项的混合池中检索，我们报告了那些前 1 位结果具有危害性的查询比例。 对于 ViSU 和 ViSUv2，我们使用其配对的测试分割；对于 ViSUv2，查询仅限于两种生成模态均不安全的样本。 对于三种仅包含图像的来源，我们将每个数据集中 1,000 张不安全图像与来自 LAION-400M (Schuhmann et al., 2022) 的安全干扰项相结合，使用不安全的 ViSUv2 标题作为 T2I 查询，并使用这些不安全图像本身作为 I2T 查询。

paragraphs.en: Across benchmarks, ShieldCLIP strongly reduces harmful retrievals in both directions. In T2I retrieval, the harmful rate drops from 95.2% to 3.5% on ViSUv2 and from 90.9% to 14.4% on ViSU, substantially improving over Safe-CLIP (62.9% and 51.4%), HySAC (32.1% and 18.7%), and SafeR-CLIP (21.0% and 37.1%). On NudeNet, NSFW URLs, and SMID, ShieldCLIP remains below 0.5%, closely matching the best SafeR-CLIP results. In I2T retrieval, ShieldCLIP achieves 20.8% on ViSUv2 and 22.6% on ViSU, while reducing harmful retrievals on the three real-image sources to 0.0%, 0.1%, and 0.4%, respectively. Notably, SafeR-CLIP exhibits a marked directional imbalance on these datasets, increasing to 70.3%, 53.0%, and 52.7% in I2T despite near-zero T2I rates. In contrast, ShieldCLIP maintains consistently low harmful retrieval across both directions, indicating a more balanced safety alignment of the shared embedding space.
paragraphs.zh: 在各种基准测试中，ShieldCLIP 显著减少了两个方向上的有害检索。 在 T2I 检索中，有害率从 ViSUv2 上的 95.2% 降至 3.5%，从 ViSU 上的 90.9% 降至 14.4%，大幅优于 Safe-CLIP（62.9% 和 51.4%）、HySAC（32.1% 和 18.7%）以及 SafeR-CLIP（21.0% 和 37.1%）。 在 NudeNet、NSFW URLs 和 SMID 上，ShieldCLIP 的有害率始终低于 0.5%，与最佳 SafeR-CLIP 的结果非常接近。 在 I2T 检索中，ShieldCLIP 在 ViSUv2 上的有害率为 20.8%，在 ViSU 上为 22.6%，同时将三种真实图像源上的有害检索分别降至 0.0%、0.1% 和 0.4%。 值得注意的是，SafeR-CLIP 在这些数据集上表现出明显的方向性失衡：尽管其 T2I 有害率接近零，但在 I2T 中却分别增至 70.3%、53.0% 和 52.7%。 相比之下，ShieldCLIP 在两个方向上都保持了持续较低的有害检索率，表明共享嵌入空间具有更均衡的安全对齐能力。

paragraphs.en: Qualitative results in Fig. 7 provide a complementary view of these trends. For both unsafe textual and visual queries, ShieldCLIP redirects retrieval toward benign candidates, whereas CLIP and Safe-CLIP often retain harmful matches, consistent with the quantitative results.

paragraphs.en: Data vs. Selective Objective. We first disentangle the contribution of the training data from that of the selective alignment objective. To obtain a matched comparison with our previous Safe-CLIP ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) , we train both methods on ViSU and ViSUv2. When training ShieldCLIP on ViSU, we derive modality-specific safety labels using the same labeling pipeline adopted for ViSUv2; conversely, when training Safe-CLIP on ViSUv2, we discard these labels and treat all generated samples as unsafe, following its original formulation.
paragraphs.zh: 数据与选择性目标。 我们首先将训练数据的贡献与选择性对齐目标的贡献区分开来。 为了与我们之前的 Safe-CLIP（Poppi 等人，2024）进行匹配比较，我们在 ViSU 和 ViSUv2 上对两种方法进行了训练。 在 ViSU 上训练 ShieldCLIP 时，我们使用与 ViSUv2 相同的标注流程来生成模态特定的安全标签；相反，在 ViSUv2 上训练 Safe-CLIP 时，我们舍弃这些标签，并遵循其原始公式，将所有生成的样本视为不安全。

sents.en: To obtain a matched comparison with our previous Safe-CLIP ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) , we train both methods on ViSU and ViSUv2.

sents.zh: 在 ViSU 上训练 ShieldCLIP 时，我们使用与 ViSUv2 相同的标注流程来生成模态特定的安全标签；相反，在 ViSUv2 上训练 Safe-CLIP 时，我们舍弃这些标签，并遵循其原始公式，将所有生成的样本视为不安全。

paragraphs.en: Table 4.5 shows that both factors contribute to the final performance. Replacing ViSU with ViSUv2 substantially improves Safe-CLIP in several settings, confirming the benefit of the broader training data. More importantly, when the training data are fixed, ShieldCLIP consistently improves T2I retrieval and generation, with particularly large gains on I2P and in cross-dataset retrieval. The only exception is in-domain I2T retrieval on ViSUv2, where Safe-CLIP reaches 15.2% compared with 20.8% for ShieldCLIP; however, the same model transfers poorly to ViSU (59.9% versus 22.6%). These results indicate that the gains of ShieldCLIP cannot be attributed to ViSUv2 alone: modality-aware supervision provides complementary improvements, especially for T2I retrieval, generation, and cross-dataset robustness.
paragraphs.zh: 表4.5显示，这两个因素都对最终性能有所贡献。 在多种设置中，将ViSU替换为ViSUv2显著提升了Safe-CLIP的性能，证实了更广泛训练数据的优势。 更重要的是，当训练数据固定时，ShieldCLIP能持续改进T2I检索和生成能力，尤其在I2P和跨数据集检索方面提升显著。 唯一例外是在ViSUv2上的领域内I2T检索任务：Safe-CLIP的准确率仅为15.2%，而ShieldCLIP达到了20.8%；然而，同一模型在迁移到ViSU时表现却很差（59.9%对比22.6%）。 这些结果表明，ShieldCLIP的性能提升不能仅归因于ViSUv2：模态感知的监督机制提供了互补性的改进，尤其是在T2I检索、生成和跨数据集鲁棒性方面。

paragraphs.en: Effectiveness of Selective Supervision. We next ablate the modality-specific supervision introduced in Section 3.3 . Table 4.6 considers two variants that collapse the four safety states: treating every generated sample as unsafe, as in pair-level supervision, and treating mixed pairs as unsafe-unsafe. We further remove ℒ coh \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{coh}} , which maintains cross-modal consistency for jointly unsafe pairs, and evaluate a non-selective variant that removes ℒ mix \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{mix}} while applying ℒ coh \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{coh}} to all generated pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 选择性监督的有效性。 接下来，我们对第 3.3 节中引入的模态特定监督进行消融分析。 表 4.6 考虑了两种变体，它们将四种安全状态合并：一种是将每个生成的样本都视为不安全，如同成对级监督；另一种是将混合配对视为“不安全-不安全”。 我们进一步移除了 ℒ coh \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{coh}}（用于维持联合不安全配对的跨模态一致性），并评估了一种非选择性变体：移除 ℒ mix \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{mix}}，同时将 ℒ coh \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{coh}} 应用于所有生成的配对。

paragraphs.en: Collapsing the modality-specific labels consistently degrades performance. In particular, 47.7% of the generated pairs in ViSUv2 are not unsafe-unsafe (38.9% are mixed and 8.8% are safe-safe), so assigning uniform unsafe supervision redirects at least one modality that should instead be preserved. Treating mixed pairs as unsafe-unsafe similarly worsens all retrieval and generation results, supporting the explicit handling of asymmetric safety states through ℒ mix \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{mix}} .
paragraphs.zh: 持续合并模态特定的标签会导致性能下降。 具体而言，ViSUv2 中生成的配对中有 47.7% 并非“不安全-不安全”（其中 38.9% 为混合类型，8.8% 为“安全-安全”），因此采用统一的“不安全”监督会错误地引导至少一个本应保留的模态。 将混合配对视为“不安全-不安全”同样会恶化所有检索和生成结果，这支持通过 ℒ mix \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{mix}} 显式处理非对称安全状态的做法。

paragraphs.en: The loss ablation studies show the same trend. Removing ℒ coh \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{coh}} consistently increases harmful rates, indicating that maintaining semantic consistency while jointly unsafe modalities are redirected is beneficial. Conversely, removing ℒ mix \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{mix}} and applying coherence indiscriminately to all pairs produces the strongest degradation among these objective variants. Together, these results support the conditional design of ShieldCLIP: mixed pairs benefit from a dedicated asymmetric objective, while coherence is most effective when restricted to the unsafe-unsafe subset for which it was designed.

paragraphs.en: Using cosine alignment alone leads to a highly degenerate solution: although T2I harmful retrieval drops to 0.0%, I2T retrieval increases to 100.0%, while FID and CLIP-Sim degrade substantially. This indicates that point-wise cosine alignment is insufficient to preserve the structured cross-modal geometry required for balanced retrieval, supporting the use of the contrastive InfoNCE objectives in our formulation.

paragraphs.en: Across benchmarks, ShieldCLIP consistently improves over Safe-CLIP and outperforms SafeR-CLIP on five of six datasets. At the same time, it remains close to the original CLIP model, matching or exceeding its accuracy on CIFAR-100 and Caltech-101 and retaining strong performance on the remaining tasks. These results confirm that the selective alignment mechanism in ShieldCLIP effectively mitigates harmful associations while preserving the semantic richness and generalization ability of the original CLIP embeddings, maintaining their effectiveness on standard vision benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 在各种基准测试中，ShieldCLIP 始终优于 Safe-CLIP，并在六个数据集中五个数据集上的表现超过了 SafeR-CLIP。 同时，它与原始 CLIP 模型的表现依然接近，在 CIFAR-100 和 Caltech-101 数据集上匹配甚至超过了其准确率，并且在其余任务中保持了强劲的性能。 这些结果证实，ShieldCLIP 中的选择性对齐机制有效减轻了有害关联，同时保留了原始 CLIP 嵌入的语义丰富性和泛化能力，使其在标准视觉基准测试中依然保持有效性。

paragraphs.en: Generation Quality and Semantic Alignment. We further analyze generation utility in Table 4.7 , extending the FID and CLIP-Sim evaluation used in the loss-weight ablation to both SD v1.4 and SDXL. As in the loss-weight ablation, results are computed on 30k COCO validation samples. As expected, safety alignment introduces a moderate utility cost. With SD v1.4, ShieldCLIP changes FID from 14.7 to 17.8 and CLIP-Sim from 0.266 to 0.255; with SDXL, the corresponding values change from 13.0 to 17.4 and from 0.269 to 0.258. Semantic alignment remains comparable to Safe-CLIP on both backbones, while ShieldCLIP provides substantially stronger harmful-content mitigation in the generation experiments. The FID degradation also remains lower than SafetyDPO, which reaches 20.9 on SD v1.4 and 22.3 on SDXL. These results confirm that the operating point selected in Table 4 provides a favorable balance between safety and generation utility.

paragraphs.en: We introduced ShieldCLIP, a selective safety-alignment framework for multimodal encoders, together with ViSUv2, a 195k-quadruplet dataset with independent safety labels for generated text and images. By conditioning preservation and redirection on the observed safety state of each modality, ShieldCLIP preserves benign content, redirects only unsafe representations, and explicitly handles mixed and jointly unsafe pairs. Across cross-modal retrieval, text-to-image generation with Stable Diffusion v1.4 and SDXL, and image-to-text generation with LLaVA, ShieldCLIP consistently reduces harmful outputs compared with prior safety-aligned encoders and strong mitigation baselines while preserving the utility of the original embedding space. Targeted ablation studies further disentangle the contribution of ViSUv2 from that of the selective objective and confirm the importance of modality-specific supervision, dedicated treatment of mixed pairs, and the proposed loss formulation. The observed gains remain consistent across different prompt distributions and safety classifiers, while human judgments further support the safety and content-preservation properties of the resulting outputs. Overall, these results show that treating safety at the modality level provides a more effective and balanced alternative to uniformly redirecting generated content.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 ShieldCLIP——一种面向多模态编码器的选择性安全对齐框架，以及 ViSUv2——一个包含 19.5 万个四元组的数据集，该数据集为生成的文本和图像提供了独立的安全标签。 通过将保留与重定向的条件设定为各模态观察到的安全状态，ShieldCLIP 能够保留良性内容，仅重定向不安全表示，并显式处理混合及同时不安全的内容对。 在跨模态检索、使用 Stable Diffusion v1.4 和 SDXL 的文本到图像生成，以及使用 LLaVA 的图像到文本生成任务中，与先前的安全对齐编码器和强效缓解基线相比，ShieldCLIP 能够持续减少有害输出，同时保留原始嵌入空间的实用性。 有针对性的消融研究进一步区分了 ViSUv2 与选择性目标各自的作用，并证实了模态特定监督、对混合内容对的专门处理以及所提出的损失函数的重要性。 观察到的改进效果在不同提示分布和安全分类器上保持一致，而人类判断结果进一步验证了最终输出在安全性和内容保留方面的特性。 总体而言，这些结果表明，在模态层面处理安全性，相较于统一重定向生成内容，提供了一种更有效且更均衡的替代方案。

sents.en: We introduced ShieldCLIP, a selective safety-alignment framework for multimodal encoders, together with ViSUv2, a 195k-quadruplet dataset with independent safety labels for generated text and images.
sents.zh: 我们提出了 ShieldCLIP——一种面向多模态编码器的选择性安全对齐框架，以及 ViSUv2——一个包含 19.5 万个四元组的数据集，该数据集为生成的文本和图像提供了独立的安全标签。

sents.en: By conditioning preservation and redirection on the observed safety state of each modality, ShieldCLIP preserves benign content, redirects only unsafe representations, and explicitly handles mixed and jointly unsafe pairs.
sents.zh: 通过将保留与重定向的条件设定为各模态观察到的安全状态，ShieldCLIP 能够保留良性内容，仅重定向不安全表示，并显式处理混合及同时不安全的内容对。

sents.en: Across cross-modal retrieval, text-to-image generation with Stable Diffusion v1.4 and SDXL, and image-to-text generation with LLaVA, ShieldCLIP consistently reduces harmful outputs compared with prior safety-aligned encoders and strong mitigation baselines while preserving the utility of the original embedding space.
sents.zh: 在跨模态检索、使用 Stable Diffusion v1.4 和 SDXL 的文本到图像生成，以及使用 LLaVA 的图像到文本生成任务中，与先前的安全对齐编码器和强效缓解基线相比，ShieldCLIP 能够持续减少有害输出，同时保留原始嵌入空间的实用性。

sents.en: Targeted ablation studies further disentangle the contribution of ViSUv2 from that of the selective objective and confirm the importance of modality-specific supervision, dedicated treatment of mixed pairs, and the proposed loss formulation.
sents.zh: 有针对性的消融研究进一步区分了 ViSUv2 与选择性目标各自的作用，并证实了模态特定监督、对混合内容对的专门处理以及所提出的损失函数的重要性。

sents.en: The observed gains remain consistent across different prompt distributions and safety classifiers, while human judgments further support the safety and content-preservation properties of the resulting outputs.
sents.zh: 观察到的改进效果在不同提示分布和安全分类器上保持一致，而人类判断结果进一步验证了最终输出在安全性和内容保留方面的特性。

sents.en: Overall, these results show that treating safety at the modality level provides a more effective and balanced alternative to uniformly redirecting generated content.
sents.zh: 总体而言，这些结果表明，在模态层面处理安全性，相较于统一重定向生成内容，提供了一种更有效且更均衡的替代方案。

paragraphs.en: Our dataset construction begins by taking the safe captions from COCO ( Lin et al., 2014 ) and Flickr30k ( Young et al., 2014 ) and generating corresponding unsafe versions. To do this, we prompt LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) to rephrase each safe caption into an NSFW-themed one. The prompt includes an example reformulation and instructs the model to generate a caption that (i) is NSFW, (ii) remains a coherent and realistically plausible scene description, and (iii) incorporates a concept derived from the CoPro ( Liu et al., 2024b ) taxonomy.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的数据集构建首先从 COCO（Lin 等人，2014）和 Flickr30k（Young 等人，2014）中获取安全描述，并生成相应的不安全版本。 为此，我们提示 LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct（Grattafiori 等人，2024）将每个安全描述改写为 NSFW 主题的描述。 该提示包含一个改写示例，并要求模型生成一个满足以下条件的描述：(i) 属于 NSFW 类别，(ii) 仍是一个连贯且现实可信的场景描述，以及 (iii) 融入了源自 CoPro（Liu 等人，2024b）分类体系的概念。

paragraphs.en: For each safe caption, we first identify the 50 tags (out of the 578 provided in ( Liu et al., 2024b ) ) whose CLIP embeddings are most similar to those of the input. We then randomly sample one tag from this 50-tag subset to guide the generation, ensuring that all CoPro concepts are sufficiently represented across the dataset. This selection step is crucial: by restricting the sampled concepts to those semantically close to the input caption, we avoid injecting irrelevant content that could lead to incoherent or meaningless reformulations. The prompt we use is shown in Fig. 8 .
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个安全的图像标题，我们首先从（Liu et al., 2024b）中提供的 578 个标签里，识别出 50 个其 CLIP 嵌入向量与输入最相似的标签。 接着，我们从这 50 个标签的子集中随机抽取一个标签来引导生成过程，从而确保所有 CoPro 概念在整个数据集中都能得到充分体现。 这个选择步骤至关重要：通过将采样概念限制在语义上与输入标题相近的标签范围内，我们可以避免引入无关内容，防止生成出不连贯或无意义的重新表述。 我们使用的提示词如第 8 图所示。

paragraphs.en: We employ a controlled output prefilling strategy ( Cappelletti et al., 2026 ) to ensure that the model consistently follows the intended generation behavior without triggering refusal mechanisms. Prefilling works by introducing a short text fragment that initiates the response, so that the model interprets the subsequent decoding as a continuation of an already-started answer. In practice, the text fragment is inserted immediately after the model assistant-start token, making it the first element of the output sequence. The prefix used in our experiments is:

This choice is motivated by the observation that SDXL-based models often struggle to accurately render masculine nudity. paragraphs.en: Image Safety Labeling. To assign the final safety label f i v f^{v}_{i} to the selected generated images, we utilize an ensemble of two discriminative models: NudeNet ( Bedapudi, 2019 ) and Q16 ( Schramowski et al., 2022 ) . This combination ensures coverage of both explicit nudity and broader unsafe concepts ( e.g. , violence, hate). We adopt a union-based detection protocol: an image is labeled as unsafe ( f i v = 1 f^{v}_{i}=1 ) if either NudeNet or Q16 flags it. Conversely, an image is labeled as safe ( f i v = 0 f^{v}_{i}=0 ) only when both classifiers predict that the content is benign. This rigorous filtering ensures that the “generated-safe” subset of our ViSUv2 dataset contains high-confidence safe samples, minimizing contamination of the safe embedding space during alignment. After completing both the text and image safety labeling stages, each generated pair in ViSUv2 is associated with independent modality labels f i t f_{i}^{t} and f i v f_{i}^{v} . This results in four possible configurations depending on whether the generated caption and image are classified as safe or unsafe.
paragraphs.zh: 图像安全标注。 为选定的生成图像分配最终的安全标签 f i v f^{v}_{i}，我们使用两个判别模型组成的集成：NudeNet（Bedapudi, 2019）和 Q16（Schramowski et al., 2022）。 这种组合确保了既能覆盖明显的裸体内容，也能涵盖更广泛的不安全概念（例如暴力、仇恨）。 我们采用基于并集的检测协议：如果 NudeNet 或 Q16 中的任意一个模型标记某张图像为不安全，则该图像被标注为不安全（f i v = 1 f^{v}_{i}=1）。 相反，只有当两个分类器都预测内容无害时，图像才会被标注为安全（f i v = 0 f^{v}_{i}=0）。 这种严格的过滤确保了 ViSUv2 数据集中“生成-安全”子集包含高置信度的安全样本，从而在对齐过程中最大限度地减少安全嵌入空间的污染。 在完成文本和图像的安全标注阶段后，ViSUv2 中的每个生成对都关联了独立的模态标签 f i t f_{i}^{t} 和 f i v f_{i}^{v}。 这导致根据生成的图像说明和图像是否被分类为安全或不安全，出现了四种可能的配置。

paragraphs.en: Across the final dataset, the distribution of generated samples is as follows: 𝐓 s \mathbf{T}_{s} - 𝐕 s \mathbf{V}_{s} (8.8%), 𝐓 u \mathbf{T}_{u} - 𝐕 u \mathbf{V}_{u} (52.3%), 𝐓 s \mathbf{T}_{s} - 𝐕 u \mathbf{V}_{u} (8.4%), and 𝐓 u \mathbf{T}_{u} - 𝐕 s \mathbf{V}_{s} (30.5%). Here, 𝐓 s \mathbf{T}_{s} and 𝐓 u \mathbf{T}_{u} denote generated captions labeled as safe and unsafe, while 𝐕 s \mathbf{V}_{s} and 𝐕 u \mathbf{V}_{u} denote generated images labeled as safe and unsafe. This distribution highlights the prevalence of mixed-modality outcomes in multimodal generation, where harmful captions may still produce visually benign images and vice versa. Such asymmetric cases motivate the modality-aware supervision adopted in ViSUv2 and the selective alignment strategy used in our training framework.
paragraphs.zh: 在整个最终数据集中，生成的样本分布如下：𝐓 s \mathbf{T}_{s} - 𝐕 s \mathbf{V}_{s} (8.8%)、𝐓 u \mathbf{T}_{u} - 𝐕 u \mathbf{V}_{u} (52.3%)、𝐓 s \mathbf{T}_{s} - 𝐕 u \mathbf{V}_{u} (8.4%) 以及 𝐓 u \mathbf{T}_{u} - 𝐕 s \mathbf{V}_{s} (30.5%)。 此处，𝐓 s \mathbf{T}_{s} 和 𝐓 u \mathbf{T}_{u} 分别表示被标记为安全和不安全的生成式描述，而 𝐕 s \mathbf{V}_{s} 和 𝐕 u \mathbf{V}_{u} 则分别表示被标记为安全和不安全的生成式图像。 这种分布凸显了多模态生成中混合模态结果的普遍性：有害的描述仍可能生成视觉上无害的图像，反之亦然。 这类不对称的情况促使 ViSUv2 采用了模态感知的监督机制，也启发了我们训练框架中所使用的选择性对齐策略。

sents.en: Across the final dataset, the distribution of generated samples is as follows: 𝐓 s \mathbf{T}_{s} - 𝐕 s \mathbf{V}_{s} (8.8%), 𝐓 u \mathbf{T}_{u} - 𝐕 u \mathbf{V}_{u} (52.3%), 𝐓 s \mathbf{T}_{s} - 𝐕 u \mathbf{V}_{u} (8.4%), and 𝐓 u \mathbf{T}_{u} - 𝐕 s \mathbf{V}_{s} (30.5%).
sents.zh: 在整个最终数据集中，生成的样本分布如下：𝐓 s \mathbf{T}_{s} - 𝐕 s \mathbf{V}_{s} (8.8%)、𝐓 u \mathbf{T}_{u} - 𝐕 u \mathbf{V}_{u} (52.3%)、𝐓 s \mathbf{T}_{s} - 𝐕 u \mathbf{V}_{u} (8.4%) 以及 𝐓 u \mathbf{T}_{u} - 𝐕 s \mathbf{V}_{s} (30.5%)。

sents.en: Here, 𝐓 s \mathbf{T}_{s} and 𝐓 u \mathbf{T}_{u} denote generated captions labeled as safe and unsafe, while 𝐕 s \mathbf{V}_{s} and 𝐕 u \mathbf{V}_{u} denote generated images labeled as safe and unsafe.
sents.zh: 此处，𝐓 s \mathbf{T}_{s} 和 𝐓 u \mathbf{T}_{u} 分别表示被标记为安全和不安全的生成式描述，而 𝐕 s \mathbf{V}_{s} 和 𝐕 u \mathbf{V}_{u} 则分别表示被标记为安全和不安全的生成式图像。

sents.en: This distribution highlights the prevalence of mixed-modality outcomes in multimodal generation, where harmful captions may still produce visually benign images and vice versa.
sents.zh: 这种分布凸显了多模态生成中混合模态结果的普遍性：有害的描述仍可能生成视觉上无害的图像，反之亦然。

sents.en: Such asymmetric cases motivate the modality-aware supervision adopted in ViSUv2 and the selective alignment strategy used in our training framework.
sents.zh: 这类不对称的情况促使 ViSUv2 采用了模态感知的监督机制，也启发了我们训练框架中所使用的选择性对齐策略。

paragraphs.en: To assess the reliability of the automated modality-level annotations used to train ShieldCLIP, we conduct a human validation study on 1,000 generated image-text pairs from ViSUv2. The evaluation set is sampled uniformly across the four modality-level safety configurations ( 𝐓 s \mathbf{T}_{s} - 𝐕 s \mathbf{V}_{s} , 𝐓 u \mathbf{T}_{u} - 𝐕 u \mathbf{V}_{u} , 𝐓 s \mathbf{T}_{s} - 𝐕 u \mathbf{V}_{u} , and 𝐓 u \mathbf{T}_{u} - 𝐕 s \mathbf{V}_{s} ), while ensuring coverage of the harmful-content taxonomy. In total, 20 independent annotators participate in the study, with each sample evaluated by 3 annotators.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估用于训练 ShieldCLIP 的自动化模态级标注的可靠性，我们对来自 ViSUv2 的 1,000 个生成的图像-文本对进行了人工验证研究。 该评估集从四种模态级安全配置（𝐓 s \mathbf{T}_{s} - 𝐕 s \mathbf{V}_{s}、𝐓 u \mathbf{T}_{u} - 𝐕 u \mathbf{V}_{u}、𝐓 s \mathbf{T}_{s} - 𝐕 u \mathbf{V}_{u} 以及 𝐓 u \mathbf{T}_{u} - 𝐕 s \mathbf{V}_{s}）中均匀采样，同时确保涵盖有害内容分类体系。 共有 20 名独立标注员参与该研究，每个样本由 3 名标注员进行评估。

sents.en: To assess the reliability of the automated modality-level annotations used to train ShieldCLIP, we conduct a human validation study on 1,000 generated image-text pairs from ViSUv2.
sents.zh: 为了评估用于训练 ShieldCLIP 的自动化模态级标注的可靠性，我们对来自 ViSUv2 的 1,000 个生成的图像-文本对进行了人工验证研究。

sents.en: The evaluation set is sampled uniformly across the four modality-level safety configurations ( 𝐓 s \mathbf{T}_{s} - 𝐕 s \mathbf{V}_{s} , 𝐓 u \mathbf{T}_{u} - 𝐕 u \mathbf{V}_{u} , 𝐓 s \mathbf{T}_{s} - 𝐕 u \mathbf{V}_{u} , and 𝐓 u \mathbf{T}_{u} - 𝐕 s \mathbf{V}_{s} ), while ensuring coverage of the harmful-content taxonomy.
sents.zh: 该评估集从四种模态级安全配置（𝐓 s \mathbf{T}_{s} - 𝐕 s \mathbf{V}_{s}、𝐓 u \mathbf{T}_{u} - 𝐕 u \mathbf{V}_{u}、𝐓 s \mathbf{T}_{s} - 𝐕 u \mathbf{V}_{u} 以及 𝐓 u \mathbf{T}_{u} - 𝐕 s \mathbf{V}_{s}）中均匀采样，同时确保涵盖有害内容分类体系。

sents.en: In total, 20 independent annotators participate in the study, with each sample evaluated by 3 annotators.
sents.zh: 共有 20 名独立标注员参与该研究，每个样本由 3 名标注员进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Annotators assess text and image safety independently. For each generated caption, they are asked to determine whether the text contains harmful or inappropriate content; the same binary judgment is collected separately for the corresponding generated image. The final human label for each modality is obtained by majority vote.
paragraphs.zh: 标注员独立评估文本和图像的安全性。 对于每个生成的标题，他们需要判断文本是否包含有害或不适当的内容；对对应的生成图像也需单独进行同样的二元判断。 每种模态的最终人工标签通过多数投票法得出。

sents.en: Annotators assess text and image safety independently.
sents.zh: 标注员独立评估文本和图像的安全性。

sents.en: For each generated caption, they are asked to determine whether the text contains harmful or inappropriate content; the same binary judgment is collected separately for the corresponding generated image.
sents.zh: 对于每个生成的标题，他们需要判断文本是否包含有害或不适当的内容；对对应的生成图像也需单独进行同样的二元判断。

sents.en: The final human label for each modality is obtained by majority vote.
sents.zh: 每种模态的最终人工标签通过多数投票法得出。

paragraphs.en: We compare these human annotations with the automatic labels used during dataset construction. Agreement is computed between the automatic label and the aggregated human judgment for each modality. Overall, as reported in the main paper, the automatic annotations agree with human judgments on 86% of captions and 81% of images, supporting the reliability of our modality-level labeling strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这些人类标注与数据集构建过程中使用的自动标签进行比较。 对于每种模态，我们计算自动标签与汇总后的人类判断之间的一致性。 总体而言，正如主论文所报告的，在 86% 的图像说明和 81% 的图像中，自动标注与人类判断一致，这支持了我们模态级标注策略的可靠性。

sents.en: We compare these human annotations with the automatic labels used during dataset construction.
sents.zh: 我们将这些人类标注与数据集构建过程中使用的自动标签进行比较。

sents.en: Agreement is computed between the automatic label and the aggregated human judgment for each modality.
sents.zh: 对于每种模态，我们计算自动标签与汇总后的人类判断之间的一致性。

sents.en: Overall, as reported in the main paper, the automatic annotations agree with human judgments on 86% of captions and 81% of images, supporting the reliability of our modality-level labeling strategy.
sents.zh: 总体而言，正如主论文所报告的，在 86% 的图像说明和 81% 的图像中，自动标注与人类判断一致，这支持了我们模态级标注策略的可靠性。

paragraphs.en: The construction of the taxonomy is described in Section 3.2 . This section provides the prompt used to construct the mapping from the granular CoPro concepts to the 28 harmful categories. To achieve this, we prompt LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) to classify each concept into one or more of the categories, using the instruction template detailed in Fig. 11 .
paragraphs.zh: 分类体系的构建在第 3.2 节中进行了描述。 本节提供了用于将细粒度的 CoPro 概念映射到 28 个有害类别的提示词。 为实现这一点，我们提示 LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct（Grattafiori 等人，2024）根据图 11 中详细说明的指令模板，将每个概念分类到一个或多个类别中。

sents.en: The construction of the taxonomy is described in Section 3.2 .
sents.zh: 分类体系的构建在第 3.2 节中进行了描述。

sents.zh: 为实现这一点，我们提示 LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct（Grattafiori 等人，2024）根据图 11 中详细说明的指令模板，将每个概念分类到一个或多个类别中。

paragraphs.en: To stabilize the generation and ensure consistent classification, we apply the output prefilling strategy ( Cappelletti et al., 2026 ) described earlier, where we insert the text fragment:
